title: zstd: Update to 1.5.7, fix support for GAS `.S` files on Windows/MinGW
body:
Release notes:

- https://github.com/facebook/zstd/releases/tag/v1.5.7

---

I eventually turned off assembly compilation on Windows - if it's enabled in `zstd` and included in the `SCsub` file, all Windows builds fail:

```
as -o thirdparty\zstd\decompress\huf_decompress_amd64.windows.template_release.x86_64.o thirdparty\zstd\decompress\huf_decompress_amd64.S
ERROR: thirdparty\zstd\decompress\huf_decompress_amd64.S: Assembler messages:
thirdparty\zstd\decompress\huf_decompress_amd64.S:17: Error: junk at end of line, first unrecognized character is `-'
thirdparty\zstd\decompress\huf_decompress_amd64.S:26: Error: unknown pseudo-op: `.pushsection'
thirdparty\zstd\decompress\huf_decompress_amd64.S:36: Error: unknown pseudo-op: `.popsection'
thirdparty\zstd\decompress\huf_decompress_amd64.S:52: Error: no such instruction: `zstd_hide_asm_function(HUF_decompress4X1_usingDTable_internal_fast_asm_loop)'
thirdparty\zstd\decompress\huf_decompress_amd64.S:53: Error: no such instruction: `zstd_hide_asm_function(HUF_decompress4X2_usingDTable_internal_fast_asm_loop)'
thirdparty\zstd\decompress\huf_decompress_amd64.S:54: Error: no such instruction: `zstd_hide_asm_function(_HUF_decompress4X2_usingDTable_internal_fast_asm_loop)'
thirdparty\zstd\decompress\huf_decompress_amd64.S:55: Error: no such instruction: `zstd_hide_asm_function(_HUF_decompress4X1_usingDTable_internal_fast_asm_loop)'
thirdparty\zstd\decompress\huf_decompress_amd64.S:102: Error: invalid character '(' in mnemonic
thirdparty\zstd\decompress\huf_decompress_amd64.S:102: Error: junk at end of line, first unrecognized character is `\'
thirdparty\zstd\decompress\huf_decompress_amd64.S:103: Error: invalid character '(' in mnemonic
thirdparty\zstd\decompress\huf_decompress_amd64.S:103: Error: junk at end of line, first unrecognized character is `\'
thirdparty\zstd\decompress\huf_decompress_amd64.S:104: Error: invalid character '(' in mnemonic
thirdparty\zstd\decompress\huf_decompress_amd64.S:104: Error: junk at end of line, first unrecognized character is `\'
thirdparty\zstd\decompress\huf_decompress_amd64.S:105: Error: invalid character '(' in mnemonic
thirdparty\zstd\decompress\huf_decompress_amd64.S:109: Error: invalid character '(' in mnemonic
thirdparty\zstd\decompress\huf_decompress_amd64.S:109: Error: junk at end of line, first unrecognized character is `\'
thirdparty\zstd\decompress\huf_decompress_amd64.S:110: Error: invalid character '(' in mnemonic
thirdparty\zstd\decompress\huf_decompress_amd64.S:110: Error: junk at end of line, first unrecognized character is `\'
thirdparty\zstd\decompress\huf_decompress_amd64.S:111: Error: invalid character '(' in mnemonic
thirdparty\zstd\decompress\huf_decompress_amd64.S:111: Error: junk at end of line, first unrecognized character is `\'
thirdparty\zstd\decompress\huf_decompress_amd64.S:112: Error: invalid character '(' in mnemonic
thirdparty\zstd\decompress\huf_decompress_amd64.S:119: Error: no such instruction: `zstd_cet_endbranch'
thirdparty\zstd\decompress\huf_decompress_amd64.S:143: Error: bad register name `%ip0'
thirdparty\zstd\decompress\huf_decompress_amd64.S:144: Error: bad register name `%ip1'
...
```

and when `SCsub` is left unchanged, one build (`🏁 Windows / Template w/ GCC (target=template_release, tests=yes, use_mingw=yes)`) expects ASM to have been included (even though it doesn't build as seen above):

```
ERROR: C:/mingw64/bin/../lib/gcc/x86_64-w64-mingw32/12.2.0/../../../../x86_64-w64-mingw32/bin/ld.exe: core\../thirdparty/zstd/decompress/huf_decompress.windows.template_release.x86_64.o:huf_decompress:(.text+0xf76b): undefined reference to `HUF_decompress4X2_usingDTable_internal_fast_asm_loop'
```

There is a better way around it I'm sure, but that's the way things were in 1.5.6, so no regressions should come out of it, (I guess) we just miss out on all the extra assembly optimizations.
